subject: Novella Health — Action roadmap, decision owners, and confirmed next steps
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@novellahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + proposed action roadmap (next steps & owners)

Hi Elena — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap of what we heard, the goals you outlined, and a proposed action roadmap so we stay aligned. Please flag any corrections.

Pain points you called out:
- Latency-sensitive retrieval use cases for clinician-facing UI (95th pct target ~120ms).
- Cost sensitivity for embedding pipeline at scale (need predictable unit economics).
- High bar for auditability and data retention controls (legal requires 7 years for clinical notes).

Goals we agreed on:
- Pilot: 6-week technical proof focused on latency and correctness for 1 clinical workflow.
- Procurement: reach commercial terms and PO approval within 8 weeks if pilot validates.
- Security: SOC 2 evidence + KMS integration for customer-managed keys.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level):
1) Technical kickoff (owner: Aditya) — week of 4/19 — benchmark latency and set pilot SLIs.
2) Security & compliance Q&A (owner: Marcus) — share SOC 2 summary and KMS options by 4/22.
3) Pilot run (owner: Novella + Redwood) — 6-week window starting 4/26.
4) Exec review & procurement (owner: Elena / Novella procurement) — decision by 6/21.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (detailed milestones + owners).

Asks for this week:
- Elena: confirm the internal decision owner for procurement (Procurement contact + legal reviewer).
- Elena / Samir: confirm pilot start window and any blackout dates.
- Novella procurement: send any standard contract redlines or procurement checklist (I attached our MAP; happy to fill details into your template).

I’ll follow up with the updated MAP after we hear back. Thanks again — excited to move forward.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0184

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - roadmap + owners)

From: Elena Moreno <elena@novellahealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novellahealth.com>, Novella Procurement <procurement@novellahealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed action roadmap (next steps & owners)

Thanks, Priya — helpful summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement owner: that’s me (Elena) + Procurement contact Samir (cc’d). Legal reviewer will be Laura Chen (laura.chen@novellahealth.com) — I’ll loop her in once we have a draft SOW/contract.
- Pilot start: 4/26 works, but we have a large system upgrade 5/3–5/7; can we ensure no critical pilot cutovers that week?
- Security: please include a short note on data retention options — our default is 7 years but we can discuss shorter retention for ephemeral telemetry.

I attached our procurement checklist (Novella_Procurement_Checklist.pdf) — it calls out required evidence (SOC2 Type II, encryption at rest, logs with 30-day access window for audit team).

Next steps on our side: Samir will review the MAP and return any gaps by 4/19. Laura will start a light review once we have the contract draft.

Elena
Director of IT Operations, Novella Health
elena@novellahealth.com

Attachment: Novella_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (procurement checklist)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@novellahealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed action roadmap (technical notes & pilot config)

Thanks for the checklist, Elena — helpful. Technical notes and pilot proposal: 

- Pilot scope: 1 clinician workflow + embedding store for 100k documents, simulated load to reproduce 95th pct latency.
- Target infra: Redwood Dedicated pool (mixed A100 + H100), continuous batching enabled, KV cache for hot prefixes.
- Data handling: support for customer-managed KMS (we can work with your key provider), option to enable ephemeral input-only retention (30 days) for telemetry and 7-year archival for persistent records.
- SLIs: 95th perc token latency <= 120ms, end-to-end throughput 100 req/s with 512 token average prompt.

Attaching a sample pilot-config.txt with the initial container and model variant suggestions. We’ll validate specifics once we have a sanitized sample of your workload.

If that looks good I’ll schedule the technical kickoff with your infra lead for 4/20.

–Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: pilot-config.txt (text - suggested model/instance configuration)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@novellahealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novellahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@novellahealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed MAP + requested artifacts (doc links & sign-off path)

Elena / Samir / Laura — thanks for the quick turn. Per our cross-checks I’ve updated the MAP and included explicit dates and sign-off checkpoints. Summary below and link to the workbook.

Confirmed milestones & owners:
- 4/20: Technical kickoff (Aditya, Novella infra) — agenda: SLI definitions, data sanitization plan.
- 4/26–6/6: Pilot window (Novella product + Redwood engineers) — weekly SLI reviews.
- 6/9: Pilot closeout & exec demo (Priya + Elena).
- 6/16–6/21: Procurement & legal review — target PO/contract signature by 6/21.

Decision process:
- Technical sign-off: Aditya + Novella infra lead.
- Security sign-off: Marcus + Laura (Novella legal/security).
- Procurement sign-off: Elena + Samir.

Required artifacts (please share where possible):
- Sanitized sample dataset for pilot (SFTP or secure-share link).
- Any contract redlines (send to priya@redwoodinference.com).
- Proof of SOC 2 (we attached SOC2-summary.pdf) — Marcus will follow up with the detailed package.

Action items now:
- Novella: confirm dataset delivery mechanism and target delivery date (reply by 4/22).
- Novella procurement: if you have a standard PO template or redlines, please forward by 4/26.
- Redwood: we’ll open a HubSpot deal and attach the signed MAP; DocuSign envelope for SOW will be sent after pilot kickoff.

Link to updated MAP workbook: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3cREDWOOD_MAP

If all looks good I’ll send the DocuSign and calendar invites for the kickoff.

Thanks — Priya
